item.title: RBI keeps repo rate unchanged at 5.5%, lowers GDP growth projection to 6.5%
item.description: The Monetary Policy Committee of the RBI voted unanimously to keep the policy repo rate unchanged at 5.5%.

item.title: Justice Surya Kant sworn in as Chief Justice of India
item.description: President administered the oath at Rashtrapati Bhavan; he was appointed under Article 124.
